triples.rationale: Micah promises rescue from Assour when he crosses the land's borders. Isaiah similarly announces removal of the Assyrians from the land and removal of their yoke.
triples.source_text: They will shepherd Assour with the sword and Nebrod’s land in its ditch. He will rescue from Assour when he comes upon your land and steps upon your borders.

target_units.text: to destroy the Assyrians from My land and from My mountains. They will become a trampling place; their yoke will be removed from them, and their glory removed from the shoulders.”
